title: Divisible by 3 and 5
description: Write a function `divisible_by_3_and_5(n)` that returns True if `n` is divisible by both 3 and 5, and False otherwise.
examples:
divisible_by_3_and_5(15) -> True
divisible_by_3_and_5(9) -> False
divisible_by_3_and_5(10) -> False
hints: The modulo operator `%` gives you the remainder of a division.
A number is divisible by X when `n % X == 0`. You need both conditions to be true.
solution:
def divisible_by_3_and_5(n):
    return n % 3 == 0 and n % 5 == 0
explanation: `%` returns the remainder of a division. A remainder of 0 means the number divides evenly. `and` combines both conditions so both must hold.
